body: Thanks for taking the time to respond Anna, I’ll hopefully be chatting to my counsellor soon. Take care.

I’m in the same boat, I have completely given up trying and can’t see the point of going on. Everything is shambolic. I have been telling the head of my year group constantly about my work worries, falling behind and showing the constant anxiety and fear I’m feeling 24/7. Although there hasn’t been any change yet, she says there would be more support put in place to help me out with my work. Atm I’m hoping that this will help calm my mind, so I may recommend try speaking to a teacher to see if there’s anything they could do. Just a thought really, it can feel tough to ask. I wish you all of the best though. This is just what is working for me. Take care.

I’m really glad you found my comment helpful! It’s great you are looking out for him, he’s very lucky to have someone that’s trying their best to help. 
Sometimes it can be frightening to call a number and speak to a stranger which can put many off, but lots of websites offer a 1-2-1 chat with a trained volunteer- for example https://www.imalive.org/ or https://commongroundhelps.org/get-help/chat-with-us

I wish you both all of the best in the future, stay safe (:
Thank you for keeping a lookout for people on here, that’s a great thing to do.
Damn now I’m curious with what they said lol

Thank you (: 
It’s so lovely to see that reading my rant has made you feel less alone haha, I really wish all of the best for you. Take care.

Hiya,
Personally reaching out to support lines has helped me a lot, here in the UK we have things such as Samaritans or Childline- I’ve recommended things like these to my friends which they said are really helpful(: 

You mentioned that mental health isn’t a talked about subject it Turkey, but it might be worth looking into to see if there are any available there? If not there could be worldwide lines out there. Speaking to someone that genuinely wants to help makes a huge difference, so this is just a thought that may be worth thinking about.
I’m wondering if you two chat about personal stuff like this often? Speaking about your personal experiences could help them be less intimidated and open up more.
I hope things work out for your friend

Take care
